review_method: Actual Codex in-app browser viewport screenshots, source/operand audit, and SVG DOM text bounds for all 87 panels. Helper crops modify only viewBox; crossing crop boundaries are not new interfaces.
observations: DimensionWeave has an automatic transpose/copy/reshape summary, retains its independent nonlinear branch, and reopens exact operations. Nodes 14 to 9; crossings 6 to 0. Expanded nodes 12, crossings 0.

AliasExtent attaches multi-step dimension arithmetic. SharedExtent and EscapingExtent retain the multiply and feature/output bindings. UnknownExtent retains the unknown call. ConditionalExtent retains the conditional scope and phi. ExtentBoundary retains the returned shape read.
Both source and receiving detail of late cross-region context entries remain visible in ContextWeave and BoundaryWeave. No before/roles pair adds a final constraint conflict.
Transformer gains three combine-path explanations under the same generic rules, reaching 12 visible path explanations. Its automatic state remains 100 nodes and 106 edges with 57 crossings.
The same Transformer helper-open list changes 105/114 to 103/108 and 64 to 57 crossings by attaching configuration dependencies. Source operations remain in the canonical IR and proof rows.
Actual editor exports retain proof annotations, exact bindings and canonical IR. Save, unfold, reopen, refold counts are 9,12,12,9 and SVGs reproduce deterministically.
Dedicated reference comparison still shows a substantial gap in wrapper hierarchy, dense crossings, context-line length and role/frontier organization.
tradeoffs: Transformer automatic and helper-open heights grow from 4502 to 4530px, width stays 2588px. New explanation captions do not establish whole-graph compactness.
Configuration paths use source Tensor contracts without runtime execution or concrete shape evaluation. Existing global unknown-effect barriers remain conservative.
Proof annotations preserve 270 dimension dependency rows in the Transformer evaluation and increase document size. They do not assert successful execution, purity, scheduling or model family.
Local folding is reversible but does not ensure position stability under every expansion. Reference correspondence, graph-wide selection and panel coverage remain incomplete.
